connector.name: Global Exchange Rates
connector.registryDescription: Official exchange rates from central banks: latest & historical rates plus currency conversion.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.globalexchangerates.org over streamable HTTP. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace org.globalexchangerates, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.
